ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized in central lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels along margins and peduncle area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous white geometric regions in the central lateral areas of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge. Dense stochastic mottling and speckling are mapped to the transition zones between the white centers and dark perimeters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude and jaggedness on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory with an upward distal sweep terminating at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel blobs (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the dark pigment field near the central peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on distal tips and multiple small acquired nicks along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern concentrated on the inner/medial boundaries of the primary white pigment patches.
